#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""候補freeze版を固定テストで検証する。性能測定は行わない。"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CONFIGS = {
    'gcc_checked': ('/usr/bin/g++', []),
    'gcc_skip': ('/usr/bin/g++', ['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']),
    'clang_checked': ('/usr/bin/clang++', []),
    'clang_skip': ('/usr/bin/clang++', ['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']),
    'gcc_standard_checked': ('/usr/bin/g++', ['-U__SIZEOF_INT128__', '-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']),
    'gcc_standard_skip': ('/usr/bin/g++', ['-U__SIZEOF_INT128__', '-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD', '-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']),
    'gcc_sanitize_checked': ('/usr/bin/g++', ['-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer']),
    'gcc_sanitize_skip': ('/usr/bin/g++', ['-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer', '-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']),
    'clang_sanitize_checked': ('/usr/bin/clang++', ['-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer']),
    'clang_sanitize_skip': ('/usr/bin/clang++', ['-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer', '-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']),
}
TESTS = {
    'reference': HERE / 'reference_test.cpp',
    'allocation': HERE / 'allocation_test.cpp',
    'boundary': HERE / 'boundary_test.cpp',
    'exception': HERE / 'exception_test.cpp',
    'sole': HERE / 'sole_test.cpp',
}

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument('source', type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--class-name', default='BinaryTrie')
    ap.add_argument('--label', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--configs', nargs='+', choices=CONFIGS, default=list(CONFIGS))
    ap.add_argument('--tests', nargs='+', choices=TESTS, default=list(TESTS))
    args = ap.parse_args()
    source = args.source.resolve()
    folder = HERE / args.label
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    report = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': digest(source),
              'compile_cpu': 8, 'run_cpu': 10, 'cxx_standard': 'c++23',
              'test_sha256': {name: digest(TESTS[name]) for name in args.tests},
              'results': []}
    failed = False
    for name in args.configs:
        compiler, flags = CONFIGS[name]
        version = subprocess.run([compiler, '--version'], text=True, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.splitlines()[0]
        for test in args.tests:
            stem = name + '_' + test
            exe = folder / stem
            optimization = '-O1' if 'sanitize' in name else '-O2'
            command = ['taskset', '-c', '8', compiler, '-std=c++23', optimization, '-g0',
                       '-DTRIE_SOURCE="' + str(source) + '"', '-DTRIE_CLASS=' + args.class_name,
                       *(['--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'] if 'clang' in compiler else []),
                       *flags, str(TESTS[test]), '-o', str(exe)]
            build = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True)
            (folder / (stem + '.compile.log')).write_text(build.stdout + build.stderr)
            row = {'config': name, 'test': test, 'compiler': version, 'command': command, 'compile_exit': build.returncode}
            if build.returncode == 0:
                env = os.environ.copy()
                # 実行環境のptrace制約でLSanは使えない。確保試験はlive数を別途照合する。
                env['ASAN_OPTIONS'] = 'detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1'
                env['UBSAN_OPTIONS'] = 'halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'
                result = subprocess.run(['taskset', '-c', '10', str(exe)], text=True, capture_output=True, env=env)
                (folder / (stem + '.run.log')).write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr)
                row.update(run_exit=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)
                failed |= result.returncode != 0
            else:
                failed = True
            report['results'].append(row)
            (folder / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    if digest(source) != report['sha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('source changed during validation')
    return 1 if failed else 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

reproduction: 各ファイルを相対配置へ取り出し、作業パス/CPUを環境へ合わせる。main_gate用は以前保存したSet Xor-Min公式12入力とその公式参照解のgolden。性能記録のfixture hashで照合する。APIは同じkeys/queries/seedを別binaryで比較し、checksumも照合。
